info.title: PlaneMem proposal directory, detail and submission identity
info.description: Source-only contract for three existing GET routes. Load this file, context-history OpenAPI and ../schemas/proposal-read.json locally with their paths/IDs preserved. No generation, compatibility, runtime or release evidence. Creation, review and original receipt POSTs are outside this document.

servers.description: Relative Gateway base; configure the actual origin/base path.

x-runtime-boundaries.authentication: All three require Bearer and authorized tenant/workspace/project headers. Expected actor/client headers are independently optional exact preconditions, not identity overrides. List/detail allow the authenticated-context client fallback. Submission identity additionally requires authenticated_client=true. No post-read session-expiry recheck on these routes.
x-runtime-boundaries.policy: List/detail execute context.read through configured Policy/OPA and await the entry decision audit before storage. With configured OPA its decision replaces local policy; SQL restricted visibility still requires actual data.restricted.read. Submission identity returns directly before command routing, Policy, decision audit and ApiGateway actor/path limiter.
x-runtime-boundaries.http: These GET handlers do not read or explicitly reject request bodies/framing, Content-Encoding, range or cache-condition headers. No conditional206/304 semantics. List/detail parse generic If-Match/If-Match-Version for syntax/equality but do not use them to condition the read; Idempotency-Key is captured without making reads idempotent. Submission identity returns before even this generic precondition parsing. Query fields are independently strict as described per operation.
x-runtime-boundaries.budgets: No dedicated complete-success byte limit, two-slot admission gate or whole-operation deadline for these reads. Directory is row-count bounded; detail checks source counts and selected metadata. No full response-schema parser is executed by Gateway or the generic SDK list/detail envelope methods. Do not import the original-receipt clients' limits into these GET guarantees.

get.description: One SQL statement selects visible proposals in this scope, applies status/kind/before/direct-parent filters, orders by proposal_id descending and fetches limit+1. Return first limit summaries and next_before=last returned ID only when lookahead exists. before is an exclusive ULID, not a signed cursor bound to identity/filters/limit or a cross-page snapshot. Repeat filters explicitly on continuation. Visibility requires a nondeleted visible parent project, proposal classification, all manifest local sources present/nondeleted/visible, and the same local checks along the bounded same-scope derivation chain; missing/cyclic/overlong lineage is hidden. Restricted reads require actual data.restricted.read, even for admin. Parent visibility is evaluated per row: a missing/hidden project produces an empty200 directory, not an independent404. No source freshness traversal or expiry/status exclusion unless requested status filters it. Summary conversion checks ID/safe revision/dates; it does not validate full provenance/content/manifests or the lookahead summary. review_allowed requires human+verified client+review capability/admin; create_allowed requires verified client+write capability/admin; neither rechecks expiry or grants later Policy approval.
get.x-query-boundary: Only status/kind/before/limit/derived_from, each once; blank values invalid. limit wire value is ASCII digits of any length including leading zeros, converted to Number then checked safe1..100; default25. derived_from matches only direct child provenance, not all descendants and not an independently looked-up parent.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Wire digits including leading zeros; numeric value1..100, absent defaults25. Decoded numeric query is separately defined.

200.description: Complete summary page including all three capability hints. One proposal-list source with the requested project ID; no outer revision/etag/cursor or HTTP ETag. No has_more/count fields.

get.summary: Read a complete visible proposal and current local-source observation
get.description: No URL query fields. Decode path ID once and require a ULID. In one repeatable-read read-only transaction, find the proposal under the same parent/source/lineage visibility rules as the directory; missing or hidden returns404. Validate stored source references, unique local-source manifest bindings/hash syntax and provenance, then normalize dates and revision. Return stored content, original trace, reviewer fields and derivation provenance; internal source_manifest is omitted, other stored row/provenance/source extensions preserved. sources_current compares pinned local context-item revisions, active status/expiry, source hashes and dependency hashes from inspectContextSources. Legacy manifests without dependency_hash produce false; nonlocal references are not fetched and an empty local manifest produces true. This flag does not check the proposal's own expiry, validate all ancestors' freshness or authorize a review. Expired/final proposals remain readable. review_allowed is the same independent human/client/capability hint as the directory, not coupled to status/expiry/freshness. No post-transaction expiry recheck or original-command/event-integrity proof.

200.description: Complete proposal plus sources_current/review_allowed. JSON revision/etag and HTTP ETag match proposal.revision. First outer source pins that proposal; remaining sources preserve its saved source order. Outer trace is current, inner trace is saved. Stale sources yield200 with false, not409. ETag is metadata, without conditional304/412 processing.

ETag.description: Equals JSON etag and canonical weak version tag of data.proposal.revision.

get.description: Direct HTTP special route takes precedence over the proposal detail template. Reject any URL query. Authenticate scope/token and optional expected actor/client, then require authenticated_client=true. Return current identity_preconditions=1 and five identity fields. No command-router operation, context.read/proposal.write capability gate, Policy/OPA evaluation, decision audit or ApiGateway rate-limit execution. No proposal/project/storage query and no permission or storage-readiness promise. The handler returns before generic If-Match/If-Match-Version/Idempotency-Key parsing; it has no dedicated body/cache/range/encoding rejection. Missing capability alone does not make this identity request fail.

200.description: Current identity envelope with empty sources; no token expiry, capability hints, revision/etag/cursor or HTTP ETag. Direct writeJson sets cache-control:no-store and does not set x-trace-id; retain trace_id in JSON.

ProposalId.name: proposal_id
ProposalId.description: Single decoded ULID of the saved proposal.

TenantId.description: Required nonempty tenant exactly matching authorized scope; this HTTP boundary does not independently require ULID syntax.

WorkspaceId.description: Required nonempty workspace exactly matching authorized scope.

ProjectId.description: Required nonempty project exactly matching authorized scope.

TraceParent.description: Nonempty opaque trace value takes precedence over x-trace-id; no W3C format or paired-header equality check.

TraceId.description: Used when traceparent absent/empty; generates trace_http_<ULID> if both absent/empty.

Error.description: Application error envelope; transport/proxy failures can use another representation. No automatic retry or response-size promise.

BadInput.description: INVALID_INPUT for malformed path encoding/ID, unsupported/duplicate/blank filters, bad limit or detail query. INVALID_REQUEST_CONTEXT for malformed/disagreeing generic version headers. retryable=false. Storage availability is checked before handler-level filter parsing, so missing storage can yield503 first.

IdentityBadInput.description: INVALID_INPUT for any query fields. Generic version headers are not parsed on this direct route. retryable=false.

Unauthenticated.description: UNAUTHENTICATED for missing/rejected Bearer token; retryable=false. Early failures do not guarantee WWW-Authenticate or x-trace-id.

Denied.description: DENIED for unauthorized scope, expected-identity mismatch or Policy denial; retryable=false. Hidden detail returns404, hidden directory rows are omitted.

IdentityDenied.description: DENIED for unauthorized scope, expected-identity mismatch or missing verified client; retryable=false. No writer/reviewer capability check on this route.

NotFound.description: PROPOSAL_NOT_FOUND for missing or currently invisible detail, including parent/source/lineage restrictions; retryable=false.

RateLimited.description: RATE_LIMITED from generic actor/path limiter; retryable=true. No dedicated read slots or Retry-After promise. Direct submission identity bypasses this limiter.

InvalidStored.description: PROPOSAL_INVALID for selected invalid stored ID/version/dates/provenance/source manifest; retryable=false. Unexpected command-boundary INTERNAL_ERROR defaults retryable=true. Not a claim that all malformed stored fields are checked.

Unavailable.description: PROPOSAL_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE for missing database or non-ContractError storage/read/source-inspection failure. WORKBENCH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE or AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE at outer boundaries. retryable=true. No synthesized proposal or in-memory fallback.

IdentityUnavailable.description: WORKBENCH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE for missing/unavailable verifier; retryable=true. This direct handler does not query proposal storage or await a command decision audit.
